question: Which courses did Daniel Kim teach in Spring 2026?

plan.reason: The question asks for courses taught by a specific teacher in a specific semester, which can be answered with a single query.
steps: Find the courses (id and title) taught by the teacher named Daniel Kim (id and name) in the semester named Spring 2026 (id and name).
Find the courses (id and title) taught by the teacher named Daniel Kim (id and name) in the semester named Spring 2026 (id and name).

changes.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.title
FROM courses c
JOIN course_offerings co ON c.id = co.course_id
JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id
JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id
WHERE t.name = 'Daniel Kim' AND s.name = 'Spring 2026';

SELECT c.id, c.title
FROM courses c
JOIN course_offerings co ON c.id = co.course_id
JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id
JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id
WHERE t.name = 'Daniel Kim' AND s.name = 'Spring 2026'
LIMIT 200
